==About==

{{i|Berries Jubilee}} must be cooked over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}. Berries Jubilee will become {{i|Spoiled Food}} if not eaten within 3 days.
